name: Memoware
storyline:
You're an archaeologist named Aria, who was called by a friend to solve secrets and whereabouts of a mysterious mountain people which this friend lived in the past.

However, mysteriously, everyone disappeared without a trace.

And how you'll uncover this? Using MEMOWARE, memory tool and with a little help from the tiny Minny, that will follow you in your journey. Uncover secrets, stories, movements, reasons and motivations.

After collecting sufficient memories, your biggest challenge will be to SORT each civilization's history chronologically, every movement, event and details will be important to complete the BOOK of every region of the mountain!

But don't think the mountain's history is over! If there's someone there, History keeps happening. Will you have some encounters during your study?

However, not only you'll recognize and preserve the mountain's history, your biggest challenge - and the main wish of Aria's friend - is to give a name to the mountain.

What will be the name you'll give to it, after many stories and adventures?
summary: Memoware! A small adventure, exploration and puzzle videogame.
